display.purpose: The agency service headline on the homepage. One per page.

headline-page.purpose: The h1 of hubs, listings and simple pages.

title.purpose: Row titles in ruled lists, tenets on the band, the closing aside heading.

lede.purpose: The sans summary under a display or page headline.

body.purpose: Interface and descriptive text; tabular numerals.

reading.purpose: Guides, articles and prose pages; running text capped at 36rem inside a 46rem column.

label.purpose: Uppercase heading of a ruled list or tinted box; never an eyebrow above a headline.

meta.purpose: Bylines (with the topic link), dates, form hints.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve (--ease); used by every transition and the masthead rule.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border and opacity changes on hover and focus.

motion.name: duration-shift
motion.purpose: Transform on index rows: title slide and chevron settle.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: 0.9s scaleX(0.12) to scaleX(1), origin left, once on load
motion.purpose: The masthead rule draws in. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion, as is every transition.

narrative.overview:
Medical Rank is an agency for local SEO and Google Ads for US medical practices. The homepage opens on a stable service headline, supporting agency copy and a primary enquiry action. Two ruled service columns explain the offer; a tinted starting-point section, a numbered delivery process, FAQs and a final blue contact band help owners decide what to do next. Resources appear lower on the homepage and have their own editorial hub.

The existing typography, blue palette and flat surfaces remain: Literata headlines, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next body text, square buttons, hairline lists and a strong masthead rule. Approved imagery is optional. No placeholder, invented result or unverified testimonial appears in the published build.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, one deep blue, dark blue-grey ink; a brighter blue appears only on hover and focus.
Literata at regular weight for every headline and row title; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for interface, labels and summaries.
Rules, not boxes: a 3px blue rule for the masthead, footer and tinted asides; 1px ink under list headings; 1px pale line between rows.
Square corners everywhere, no shadows, no gradients.
Ruled index lists in place of cards.
Two widths: an 82rem page and a 46rem reading column with running text capped at 36rem.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue. Journal Blue carries brand, links and structure; Interaction Blue exists only for hover and focus. The sole exceptions in the build are the contact form's error and success messages, which are states, not palette.

rules.name: The Rule Weight Rule
rules.body: Three rules, three meanings. 3px Journal Blue marks the masthead, footer, service columns and the top of a tinted aside. 1px Ink sits under the heading of a list. 1px Pale Line separates rows and sections. 2px Journal Blue is reserved for interactive edges: the button border and the active navigation underline.

rules.name: The Regular Serif Rule
rules.body: Literata is always weight 400 on screen. Headlines gain emphasis by size and tight tracking, never by weight. Bold belongs to the sans: buttons at 600, labels at 700.

rules.name: The Label Is A Heading Rule
rules.body: The uppercase blue label is the heading of a ruled list or the label of a tinted box. It is never stacked above a larger headline as an introduction to it.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are ink on paper. A thing is set apart by a rule above it or a tint behind it, never by a shadow or a lift, at rest or on hover.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0 radius) and every surface flat: no shadows, no gradients.
Do present collections as ruled lists: uppercase blue label, 1px Ink rule, rows separated by 1px Pale Lines, serif title over sans description.
Do set every headline and row title in Literata at weight 400 and let size carry the hierarchy.
Do use the 3px Journal Blue rule for the masthead, footer, service columns and top edge of a tinted aside.
Do cap running text at 36rem and keep reading pages to one left-aligned column.
Do keep the global focus outline (3px Interaction Blue, 3px offset; white on the band).
Do honour reduced motion: every animation and transition is removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep reading pages and worksheets printable: masthead, footer and closing aside are hidden in print.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue. Blue is the only colour; red and green appear only as form status text.
Don't use Interaction Blue (#355fec) as a resting colour. It is for hover and focus.
Don't put guides, topics or services in cards, tiles or shadowed panels.
Don't set serif headings in bold on screen.
Don't stack an uppercase label above a larger headline as an eyebrow; a label heads a list or a tinted box.
Don't round corners on buttons, inputs or boxes.
Don't add motion beyond the masthead rule's single draw-in and the 0.2–0.3s hover transitions.
